goal: Add a native TELE control-plane page to the existing WoW112 WinForms updater/loader with station role configuration and diagnostics, while compile-time locking all TELE runtime mutations until headless party/invite evidence is complete.
notes: UI-only shell. Reuses existing DPAPI-protected WowAccountVault; tele_config.json stores account IDs/roles only. TeleRuntimeEnabled=false. No worker start, invite, cast or portal use. Windows updater compile + UI smoke required before any integration decision.
